title: Clinic appointment reminder
title_vi: Nhắc lịch hẹn tại phòng khám
passage:
APPOINTMENT REMINDER

Lena Ortiz has an appointment with Dr. Chen at Greenway Clinic on Tuesday, March 12, at 2:30 p.m. Patients should check in at the front desk ten minutes early. Because the clinic is repainting the east hallway, visitors should use the west entrance after noon. Lena should bring her insurance card and the medication list she prepared during her last visit. The clinic asks patients who need to reschedule to call before 10:00 a.m. on the appointment day.

title: Hotel booking change
title_vi: Thay đổi đặt phòng khách sạn

BOOKING RECORD
Guest: Omar Bell
Room: Garden View, two nights
Arrival: Friday, June 14
Breakfast: Included

HOTEL MESSAGE
The Garden View room reserved for Omar will be unavailable because a plumbing repair has taken longer than expected. The hotel can offer a Courtyard room at the same rate, or Omar may move the reservation to Saturday without a change fee. Breakfast will still be included with either option. Please reply by Wednesday evening so the front desk can prepare the room and update the arrival list.

Vui lòng trả lời trước tối thứ Tư để quầy lễ tân chuẩn bị phòng và cập nhật danh sách khách đến.

LIBRARY ORDER
Patel Learning Center
Order: six copies of River Signals
Requested pickup: Monday afternoon

EVENT NOTICE
Writer Hana Brooks will discuss River Signals at the Patel Learning Center on Monday at 5:30 p.m. The discussion is open to readers, but seats must be reserved online. Ordered copies will be placed at the information desk after the event. The center will keep unclaimed copies for five business days.

STAFF MESSAGE
The publisher has confirmed that the shipment will arrive Monday morning. Please separate the six copies for the learning center and place the pickup slips inside the order envelope. If the delivery arrives after noon, call the center director before opening the event room.

title: Campus shuttle update
title_vi: Cập nhật xe đưa đón trong khuôn viên
passage:
CAMPUS SHUTTLE UPDATE

The north loop shuttle will use a temporary stop beside the sports center from April 2 through April 6. The usual stop near the science building is closed while a sidewalk is repaired. Buses will leave the temporary stop every twenty minutes between 7:00 a.m. and 6:00 p.m. The south loop is unchanged. Students carrying large project materials may request the driver's help when boarding, but bicycles cannot be taken on the shuttle during the temporary arrangement.

Xe sẽ rời điểm dừng tạm mỗi hai mươi phút từ 7:00 sáng đến 6:00 chiều. Tuyến phía nam không thay đổi. Sinh viên mang vật liệu dự án cồng kềnh có thể nhờ tài xế giúp khi lên xe, nhưng trong thời gian tạm thời xe không nhận xe đạp.

title: Farmers market notice
title_vi: Thông báo chợ nông sản
passage:
FARMERS MARKET NOTICE

The Riverbend Farmers Market will move indoors to the community hall this Saturday because strong winds are expected. The market will open at 9:00 a.m. and close at 1:00 p.m. Vendors must enter through the rear loading door between 7:30 and 8:30 to set up. Customers may bring reusable bags, but the hall has limited bicycle parking. The music performance planned for the market will be held next Saturday instead.
passage_vi:
THÔNG BÁO CHỢ NÔNG SẢN

Người bán phải vào qua cửa bốc dỡ phía sau trong khoảng 7:30 đến 8:30 để sắp xếp. Khách có thể mang túi tái sử dụng, nhưng hội trường có ít chỗ đỗ xe đạp. Buổi biểu diễn âm nhạc dự định tổ chức ở chợ sẽ chuyển sang thứ Bảy tuần sau.

title: Community garden workday
title_vi: Ngày làm vườn cộng đồng
passage:
GARDEN SIGN-UP
Volunteer: Ruth Kim
Task: herb-bed preparation
Shift: Saturday, 8:00–10:00 a.m.
Meeting point: tool shed

GARDEN COORDINATOR'S NOTE
The workday will begin with a short safety briefing beside the tool shed. Volunteers should wear closed shoes and bring a water bottle. The garden will supply gloves, hand tools, and compost. Children may attend only with an adult who remains on site.

WEATHER MESSAGE
Light rain is expected early Saturday, but the workday will continue unless the coordinator posts a cancellation by 7:00 a.m. If the ground is too wet for the herb beds, volunteers will clean the greenhouse shelves instead.

GHI CHÚ CỦA ĐIỀU PHỐI VIÊN VƯỜN

Unused books may be returned within fourteen days with a receipt. Books with writing or highlighting cannot be returned. Online orders may be returned at the store desk or by mail, but the customer must include the order number. Refunds go back to the original payment method.
